cards.name: Copper
cards.text: Provide 1 money.
cards.headline: +1 money

cards.name: Silver
cards.text: Provide 2 money.
cards.headline: +2 money

cards.name: Gold
cards.text: Provide 3 money.
cards.headline: +3 money

cards.name: Focus
cards.text: Gain 1 mana.
cards.headline: +1 mana

cards.name: Channel
cards.text: Gain 1 mana. Draw 1 card.
cards.headline: +1 mana · +1 card

cards.name: Ley Step
cards.text: Move 1 space. Gain 1 mana. Gain 1 additional mana if you are at Far range after moving.
cards.headline: Move 1 space · +1 mana
cards.detail: +1 additional mana if you are at Far after moving.

cards.name: Attune
cards.text: Gain 1 mana. Draw 1 card. Gain 1 additional mana for each other copy of Attune you played this turn.
cards.headline: +1 mana · +1 card
cards.detail: +1 additional mana for each other Attune you played this turn.

cards.name: Prism
cards.text: Gain 2 mana. Draw 1 card, then discard 1 card.
cards.headline: +2 mana · +1 card
cards.detail: Then discard 1 card.

cards.name: Arc Bolt
cards.text: Spend 1 mana. Deal 3 damage at any range.
cards.headline: 3 damage
cards.detail: Spend 1 mana.

cards.name: Fireball
cards.text: Spend 2 mana. Deal 6 damage at any range.
cards.headline: 6 damage
cards.detail: Spend 2 mana.

cards.name: Starfire
cards.text: Spend 3 mana. Deal 12 damage at any range.
cards.headline: 12 damage
cards.detail: Spend 3 mana.

cards.name: Discharge
cards.text: Deal 2 damage at any range for each mana you have. Lose all mana.
cards.headline: 2 damage per mana
cards.detail: Lose all mana.

cards.name: Cascade
cards.text: Spend 1 mana. Deal 4 damage at any range. Deal 2 additional damage for each other spell you played this turn.
cards.headline: 4 damage
cards.detail: Spend 1 mana. +2 damage for each other spell you played this turn.

cards.name: Overload
cards.text: Deal 3 damage at any range for each mana you spent this turn.
cards.headline: 3 damage per mana spent

cards.name: Feint
cards.text: At Close range, draw 1 card. Your next two Close attacks this turn each deal 2 additional damage.
cards.headline: +1 card
cards.detail: Your next two Close attacks this turn each deal +2 damage.

cards.name: Jab
cards.text: At Close range, deal 2 damage. Draw 1 card.
cards.headline: 2 damage · +1 card

cards.name: Strike
cards.text: At Close range, deal 3 damage.
cards.headline: 3 damage

cards.name: Drive
cards.text: At Close range, deal 3 damage. Then move both fighters 1 space so they remain Close. If a wall blocks the move, neither fighter moves and the attack deals 2 additional damage.
cards.headline: 3 damage
cards.detail: Then move both fighters 1 space together. If a wall blocks the move, neither moves and the attack deals +2 damage.

cards.name: Heavy Blow
cards.text: At Close range, deal 6 damage.
cards.headline: 6 damage

cards.name: Opening Strike
cards.text: At Close range, deal 4 damage if this is the first attack you played this turn. Otherwise deal 1 damage.
cards.headline: 4 damage
cards.detail: If this is not your first attack this turn, deal 1 damage instead.

cards.name: Rally
cards.text: At Close range, deal 2 damage. Deal 2 additional damage for each other copy of Rally you played this turn.
cards.headline: 2 damage
cards.detail: +2 damage for each other Rally you played this turn.

cards.name: Bull Rush
cards.text: At Close range, discard 1 Melee card: deal 7 damage.
cards.headline: 7 damage
cards.detail: Discard 1 Melee card.

cards.name: Flurry
cards.text: Deal 1 damage for each other Tactical Action you played this turn. Tactical Actions are Melee, Ranged, or Mana Actions, plus non-Scrap Attacks and Movement Actions.
cards.headline: 1 damage per other tactical action
cards.detail: Tactical actions are Melee, Ranged, and Mage cards, plus non-Scrap Engine cards that deal damage or move you.

cards.name: Aim
cards.text: At Near or Far range, draw 1 card. Add 2 damage to the next ranged attack you make this turn. Aim bonuses stack.
cards.headline: +1 card
cards.detail: +2 damage to your next Ranged attack this turn. Aim bonuses stack.

cards.name: Peppering Shot
cards.text: At Near or Far range, deal 1 damage. Draw 1 card.
cards.headline: 1 damage · +1 card

cards.name: Steady Shot
cards.text: At Near or Far range, deal 2 damage.
cards.headline: 2 damage

cards.name: Repelling Shot
cards.text: At Far range, deal 2 damage. At Near range, deal 1 damage. Move the opponent 1 space farther away. If they cannot move, move yourself 1 space farther away instead.
cards.headline: Far: 2 damage · Near: 1 damage
cards.detail: Move the opponent 1 space farther away. If they cannot move, move yourself farther away instead.

cards.name: Longshot
cards.text: At Near or Far range, deal damage equal to the distance between you and your opponent.
cards.headline: Damage equal to distance

cards.name: Volley
cards.text: At Near range, deal 2 damage. At Far range, deal 4 damage.
cards.headline: Near: 2 damage · Far: 4 damage

cards.name: Salvage Shot
cards.text: At Near or Far range, discard 1 Ranged card: deal damage equal to its cost. Draw 1 card.
cards.headline: Damage equal to discarded card’s cost
cards.detail: Discard 1 Ranged card. +1 card.

cards.name: Precision Shot
cards.text: At Near or Far range, deal 4 damage. Each other copy of Precision Shot you play this turn deals 2 damage instead.
cards.headline: 4 damage
cards.detail: Other Precision Shots you play this turn deal 2 damage instead.

cards.name: Step
cards.text: Move 1 space.
cards.headline: Move 1 space

cards.name: Footwork
cards.text: You may move 1 space. Draw 1 card.
cards.headline: Move up to 1 space · +1 card

cards.name: Stipend
cards.text: Draw 1 card. Provide 1 money.
cards.headline: +1 card · +1 money

cards.name: Reclaim
cards.text: Put 1 card from your discard pile into your hand. If your discard pile is empty, draw 1 card.
cards.headline: Recover 1 card
cards.detail: Put it into your hand. If your discard pile is empty, +1 card instead.

cards.name: Regroup
cards.text: Draw 2 cards. Discard 1 card.
cards.headline: +2 cards
cards.detail: Discard 1 card.

cards.name: Adapt
cards.text: Draw 1 card. If your position changed this turn, draw 1 more.
cards.headline: +1 card
cards.detail: +1 card if your position changed this turn.

cards.name: Muster
cards.text: Draw 2 cards.
cards.headline: +2 cards

cards.name: Regiment
cards.text: Draw 3 cards.
cards.headline: +3 cards

cards.name: Discipline
cards.text: Trash 1 card from your hand. Deal 1 damage at any range.
cards.headline: 1 damage at any range
cards.detail: Trash 1 card from your hand.

cards.name: Cull
cards.text: Trash 1 or 2 cards from your hand.
cards.headline: Trash 1 or 2 cards

cards.name: Sharpen
cards.text: Draw 1 card. You may trash 1 card from your hand.
cards.headline: +1 card
cards.detail: You may trash 1 card from your hand.

cards.name: Reforge
cards.text: Trash 1 card from your hand. Gain a card costing up to 3 more than it.
cards.headline: Trash 1 card
cards.detail: Gain a card costing up to 3 more than it.

cards.name: Scour
cards.text: Trash up to 2 cards from your hand. Draw 1 card for each card trashed.
cards.headline: Trash up to 2 cards
cards.detail: +1 card for each card trashed.

cards.name: Improvise
cards.text: Deal 2 damage at any range for each different Mana, Melee, or Ranged family you played this turn.
cards.headline: 2 damage per family at any range
cards.detail: Count each different Mage, Melee, or Ranged family you played this turn.

cards.name: Scrap
cards.text: Deal 1 damage at any range.
cards.headline: 1 damage at any range
cards.detail: Only the first Scrap you play each turn deals damage.
